name: reccenter-tour
description: Rec Center tour from the balcony spawn: balcony run, back stairs down to the landing and the ground floor, SM64 movement tech on the open ground floor, then the merch booth counter jump.
notes: Waypoints come from live mario-state logs (balcony y 3.42 x -14..7.7 z -15.7..-11.6; back stairs (-15.8,3.2,-13.0) -> (-17.6,2.0,-14.4) -> landing y 1.59 around (-18.5,-16)), the square-walk ground-floor box x -19.6..-9.8 z -9.9..-5.2 (y 0.09), and scene6 object names read offline: [MerchBooth] (-9.84,0.08,7.39), MerchBooth_Counter (-9.79,0.08,7.17), storefront activation volume (-9.74,0.48,5.69), BackStairs collider origin (-18.89,0.08,-9.83).
The lower back-stairs flight (landing -> ground) and the ground floor north of z -5 are not verified live; a stuck result there is logged and the route continues.
Native SM64 input only; stick values are world directions (route drive + world input).

routefix (live 20261008T041115Z, 29/32): steps now wait for an action that accepts their input (backflip: ACT_IDLE; punch/kick: idle, walking or a landing stop; jumps: idle or walking), as a player would. The full-hold triple jump from (-14,-9) reached the wall at z ~8.4 during its double jump; it now starts at the lane end (-13.5,-9.6) with short hops (holdA 1, holdA2 1) and stick 0.6 after the run-up, so the third jump takes off near z 0 (model, not live). The third jump itself may still bonk the far wall; that is logged as bonk=1 and the step stays ok once ACT_TRIPLE_JUMP is seen.
